title: Chapter 183 Mission Matters
content:
Chapter 183 Mission Matters

In front of the gate of King Han's Palace, the officials had just retreated from the court, and they were discussing the major political affairs just now.

In front of this door, these two people are the most eye-catching, and the eyes of the surrounding people glance at them from time to time, and their minds are drawn to them.

"Mr. Han Fei, in this way, after today, you will be the Minister of Honglu Temple in my imperial country, and you will be a court official of the third rank!" Zhong Yu said with a smile to Han Fei who was beside him.

"That's right, I hope His Highness will give you more advice when working with His Highness Prince Jing in the future!" Han Fei said respectfully to Zhong Yu, the person who recommended him, with a solemn face.

"There's no need to do that, you and I will be officials in the same court from now on, and it's right to support each other!" Waving his hand, Zhong Yu said indifferently.

"Yes, please take care of me from now on!" Han Fei nodded and laughed.

The two walked quickly alone, and soon came to Zhongli's carriage. Han Fei had just become a member of the Yu Kingdom, and finally invited him to ride in the carriage with him, and continued to communicate in the carriage.

Han Fei didn't refuse. He was also very curious about this strange Yuguo. He just became a member of the court of Yuguo again and was about to learn more about it!

"Mr. Han Fei, since you have assumed the post of Minister of Honglu Temple, do you have a plan for the first step, that is to say, among the six countries in the world, which country do you plan to start with first?" The two people sitting were standing opposite each other, and Zhong Yu was the first to ask Han Fei.

"Among the six countries, South Korea has already agreed to the matter of co-independence. Needless to say, Yan, as the defeated country of our imperial state, as long as the imperial state has orders, he will not dare to disobey, and he can also be exempted. Qin Zhao feud, since More than 20 years ago, Qin Guokeng killed 400,000 soldiers of Zhao State, and the two countries have forged a deadly feud. Zhao State is still male, and the current situation is that there are no young people. As long as His Royal Highness conveys the intention of forming an alliance, this country will definitely obey , You don’t have to say it.” Han Fei paused, and just now he listed a few countries that could agree to form an alliance without thinking too much.

"What about the other three countries? What kind of attitude do they have!" Zhong Yu nodded, and he understood what Han Fei said.

"Ever since Qi was destroyed by the Allied Forces of the Six Nations, although it has been rebuilt again, its strength has not yet returned to its peak. Up to now, there are still many ruins in the country. He maintains an attitude of rejection towards the Six Nations. , and even faintly hostile, it is very difficult for him to join the alliance, so His Highness can directly exclude him!" Han Fei first picked the most difficult country to persuade, and suggested that Zhong Yu should not expect Qi to join the alliance.

"Qi State, this is indeed a country that is difficult to persuade!" Zhong Yu thought of South Korea in history. When facing Qin's war to unify the six countries, they would sit idly by and ignore the demise of other countries. When he was left, he simply surrendered.

With this attitude of pulling everyone to die together, Zhong Yu felt a little helpless.

"Then the next step is the Kingdom of Wei. King Wei of the Kingdom of Wei is greedy and short-sighted, but he is also extremely timid. He has always leaned on whichever side is powerful. As long as our alliance pulls up a huge momentum , resulting in a phenomenon that the world is in my hands, Wei Guo will definitely fall into our arms, and he doesn't have to persuade too much, as long as the alliance is formed, he will definitely join!" Han Fei then talked about the people around him Wei Guo, the overlord of the world in the early Warring States period.

"What about the state of Chu? Except for the state of Yu, the only country in this world that has the strength to compete with the state of Qin!" When mentioning the state of Chu, Zhong Yu couldn't help but think of the saying that although there are three families in Chu, if Qin dies, Chu must die. The overlord of Western Chu who carried the tripod.

"Among the six countries, Chu has the least dispute with Qin. It has always been Qin who took the initiative to bully Chu. Chu abandoned their capital twice because of Qin's attack! Don't they feel angry? I I heard that the Xiang clan of Chu State, whose patriarch Xiang Yan, is extremely staunch, and the clan of Chu State, the current King Changping of Qin State, still seems to be obsessed with Chu State, which can be used." Han Fei did not directly The attitude of naming Chu State, but talking about these two extremely critical figures for Chu State.

"Well, it seems that Mr. Honglu Temple has all the major issues in the world in his heart, so I won't bother too much. I have sent your official uniform to your residence, and you will accept it at that time After that, you will officially become an official of our Yuguo, and please do your best for the rise of Yuguo!" Immediately stopped, and had already reached the gate of Han Fei's mansion, Zhong Yu stood up and said to Han Fei.

"Since Han Fei is already an official of Yunguo, he must not dare to forget his duties. It is Han Fei's duty to serve Yuguo wholeheartedly!" Han Fei also responded with a solemn face.

"Well, Your Highness, please rest in South Korea for the next few days, and prepare for the mission. Five days later, I will send troops to follow you to the six countries, and ask you to persuade the six countries to join the alliance and attack Qin together! "Nodding, Zhong Yu asked Han Fei.

"Yes, Han Fei will go back and prepare now. It is better sooner rather than later to discuss the matter of Qin. Qin must not be given time to prepare!" Bowing and saluting, Han Fei returned to Zhong Yu seriously.

"Well, I won't bother you any more, goodbye!" Zhong Yu got up and got into the carriage again, ordering the driver to drive to his mansion.

Han Fei stood at his door, watching the carriage drift away surrounded by hundreds of guards.

"Yuguo, join forces to challenge Qin, Your Highness Prince Jing, what are you thinking right now?" Han Fei murmured.

Although he had only been in contact with him for a few days, Han Fei felt very strange about this King Jing. Although King Jing was said to be one of the best in the Jade Kingdom and held a lot of power in the Yu Kingdom, what he did now exceeded a The behavior of the courtiers.

"Can the emperor of Yuguo really accommodate such a King Jing?" Han Fei asked in his heart, then he shook his head and stopped thinking about it.

...

In Prince Jing's mansion, Zhong Yu had just returned to his room when footsteps came from behind him.

"Your Highness, great joy, great joy!" Zhao Yun's voice came from afar.

Hearing Zhao Yun's voice, he opened the door, and Zhong Yu came over.

"Zilong, what makes you so happy!" Zhong Yu asked curiously.

"Your Highness, there is news from the north that Cao Cao, the great general who conquered the west, led his army to defeat the Xiongnu and forced his royal family to surrender. Now there is no powerless force in the western grasslands of the imperial kingdom that can threaten the imperial kingdom." With a full face Surprisingly, Zhao Yun said this exciting news.

"Really? Cao Cao did not disappoint me!" Zhongli nodded. Although he was very happy, all of this was within his expectations.
